translation: Took place in posad Serock, 28 December 1890 at 11 AM. Appeared personally Berek Koltun, laborer, 65, and Lejbka Kendzior, shoemaker, 54, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 5 PM died a child of female sex named [first written: Sura Rozenek, one week old; officially corrected in red to: [Sura/Sara] [Geldfisz/Geldblum], three months old], daughter of [first written Jankel, corrected in red to Mortka] and his wife [first written Ryfka nee Jedwabnik, struck; red replacement uncertain: Frejda? nee Butel?]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death this act was read and signed by us; the witnesses are illiterate. A red marginal note certifies the corrections.
authority_warning: extraction is not authority - verify against the scan; this act has two ink layers (original + official red rectification) and consensus should treat them as separate assertions
